responsibility: Acts as the root of rustc's internal type-system model by re-exporting the major `ty` data structures, defining shared module-wide helper types, and wiring `ty` query providers and submodules into one public interface.
same_name_distinction: Unlike focused `ty` submodule roots such as `ty/inhabitedness/mod.rs`, `ty/print/mod.rs`, or `ty/query/mod.rs`, this is the top-level `ty` hub that re-exports the compiler’s core type representation, declares the major type-system submodules, and wires multiple `ty` providers together.
